title: The Traveling Tournament Problem: An Overview
summary: Over the past 25 years, the Traveling Tournament Problem (TTP) has become one of the most extensively studied optimization problems in sports scheduling. At its core, the TTP seeks to minimize the total travel distance incurred by teams that travel directly between opponents' venues during consecutive away games. The problem originated from the scheduling challenges faced by Major League Baseball, where it was identified as the central computational difficulty.
